items.statement: The parallel-run protocol refers to a single assigned method paragraph, but none is identifiable in the supplied prompt or tracked project records.
items.impact: Choosing a method lane would be an unsupported assumption; no experiment or new candidate raster is authorized.
items.action: Remain negative until the assigned lane is available in project context. No weekly slot used.

items.statement: Canonical evaluate_holdout.py, submission_writer.py, and the cached feature stack are absent. Similar repository-local utilities are not accepted substitutes.
items.impact: The requested holdout, leakage workflow, and canonical writer cannot be run without violating the reuse rule.
items.action: Locate/pin the shared canonical template; do not run the quarantined local pipeline as a substitute.

items.statement: The official competition feature raster is absent. Three small input rasters were restored from owner-supplied GitHub mirrors and hash-match the local manifest, but this does not authenticate them as organizer files.
items.impact: No authorized feature surface can be built; official provenance remains unproven.
items.action: Use only the authorized competition package when available; do not bypass a login gate.

items.statement: The complete registry of comparison rasters is absent. Historical H83-B evidence sampled an arbitrary subset and used binary Pearson correlation rather than the specified full-registry rank-correlation audit.
items.impact: Uniqueness before placement and final-dot overlap are unverified.
items.action: Obtain the canonical registry and run both duplicate screens before publication.

items.statement: The user-reported 0.2778 H33-2-B2 value has no submission-page receipt in the material reviewed. At pinned owner-repository snapshot f62038b54dcb7767d4d997f80b033cdc3d42bef9, the matching artifact manifest says UNSCORED and its receipt field is null; a later organizer score is possible but unverified here.
items.impact: No file-to-score attribution or ORGANIZER-CONFIRMED value is accepted.
items.action: Keep the report user-labelled and require the organizer submission-page receipt plus byte/hash match before confirming it.

items.statement: Owner code records a custom LM-calibrated proxy delta of +0.004869544 for H33-2-B2, four positive quadrants, and a projected live value of 0.274673; another owner proxy is 0.4412792647, which rounds to the user-provided current leaderboard claim 0.4413.
items.impact: These are owner proxy metrics/projections, not the required canonical HOLDOUT-DTI or organizer leaderboard scores. The rounded match creates a risk of conflating unlike evidence.
items.action: Expose the evidence class beside each number; never convert a proxy or projection to a score claim. Re-evaluate only with the canonical evaluator and organizer receipt.

items.statement: A spatially blocked hide-and-recover test on mapped fault segments is a screening proxy for the organizer's private set of new faults.
items.impact: Even a valid HOLDOUT-DTI improvement is not a guaranteed public/private leaderboard gain or verified geothermal discovery.
items.action: Report target population, evaluator, withheld positives, and uncertainty; do not equate a proxy with organizer truth.

items.statement: H32-A already combines gravity/magnetic cross-strike odd/even profile asymmetry with down-dip projection; H33-E already proposes a raw seismic catalogue plus nodal-plane strikes. Other project families cover oriented multi-physics consensus, structural tips, wavelet/scale persistence, and radiometric fusion.
items.impact: The initial phase-displacement and focal-mechanism ideas overlap prior art and have been withdrawn from the ranked candidates. Candidate wavelet phase coupling remains a tentative transform-level distinction, unreviewed against the complete sibling registry.
items.action: Use the revised candidate comparison, make no novelty claim beyond checked code/titles, and require full registry review before implementation.

items.statement: The previous published home and executive summary offered an H83-B TIFF as ready while the current card was negative; the receipt and uniqueness evidence were incomplete.
items.impact: A visitor could mistake a format pass for scientific and protocol readiness.
items.action: Moved the old files and local pipeline scripts into research/quarantine/prior-h83b; no archived TIFF is linked from the Pages site.

items.statement: The archived all-finite H83-B zeros raster passes independent format checks against an owner-mirrored template; its NaN-outside twin fails whole-grid finite/range checks. The rejected upload itself is unavailable.
items.impact: The historical portal range error cannot be causally diagnosed; format correctness is only one gate.
items.action: Keep both artifacts quarantined. Validate any future candidate from reopened final bytes against the authorized template.

items.statement: DrivenData, USGS, GDR, NLR PDF, Copernicus Data Space, EPSG and GitHub Pages hosts were not fetched in this session. GitHub owner-source snapshots were fetched and are explicitly non-organizer evidence.
items.impact: Fresh external-source verification and current live-leaderboard status are not established.
items.action: Use the manual-review links and keep source/provenance class beside each claim.

items.statement: Legacy tests expected mirror files under data/raw although the restore tool writes under data; stale site links also referenced a missing receipt/page.
items.impact: CI and the published site disagreed with the checkout and run card.
items.action: Replace data-dependent legacy submission tests with fail-closed run-card, site-link, and quarantine-receipt regression checks.

items.statement: The legacy local feed helper exposed the latest stored leaderboard rows with a generic verified flag and probed non-competition source URLs; that output could be mistaken for a current status feed.
items.impact: A generated second feed could blur historical public-page snapshots, live availability, and organizer-confirmed submission receipts.
items.action: Replaced it with a static-only compatibility helper that reads docs/data/status.json, returns registered source statuses without network requests, and writes no feed/source-health files.

items.statement: The owner-mirrored sample_submission.tif has 5,167,373 finite cells; a legacy feature-footprint count of 5,165,852 references a missing receipt, a 1,521-cell discrepancy. The mirror manifest also records 60,988 template pixels equal to 1 coincident with mirrored fault labels, despite older competition-description wording about total fault absence; the official package/page was not fetched.
items.impact: The valid mask, outside-grid encoding, and semantics of template values are unresolved. A local format pass against this mirror cannot certify the official submission grid or footprint.
items.action: Obtain the authorized feature/template rasters, resolve the footprint and 1-valued-cell behavior against official documentation, then validate reopened final bytes with the shared writer. Do not rely on the stale local footprint constant.

items.statement: The broad `data/` ignore pattern also ignored the reviewed `docs/data/` status, source, and user-score feeds, so these files were present only in the working tree and would be absent from a clean checkout.
items.impact: A clean Pages build or CI run could omit the static status and evidence registers or fail its site checks.
items.action: Scoped the ignore to root `/data/` and added the three reviewed `docs/data/` files to version control; clean-checkout tests validate them.
